name: Kaleydoskop
scene: A kaleidoscope mandala of six-fold petals, stars and diamonds.
notes: Target 31–41 panes. Six two-colour radial petals surround a coral six-point star with a gold circular centre; six gold diamonds punctuate a blue/teal background. Subject uses coral/gold only; background uses blue/teal only. Generated with clai image using the old kaleido artwork and vitray_fox/vitray_poppies style references, then regenerated once after visual inspection to simplify divisions and crossings. Final image visually inspected: closed outer oval and recognisable sixfold motif; remaining concerns include subtle fill shading, unlined blue/teal transitions near side and bottom diamonds, lower side diamonds touching petal tips, and tight contacts around the central star. These require attention during tracing and geometry preparation; design is not geometry-certified or published.
